umbrella.title: One umbrella, one submodule per chip
umbrella.alt: Layer diagram: board HALs and products build on hf-core, whose handlers use the device drivers in hf-core-drivers/external and the platform layer in hf-core-drivers/internal, which drive the chips.
umbrella.description: From top to bottom. Board HALs and products build on hf-core, whose handlers adapt each driver to the platform. hf-core-drivers holds the device drivers under external/ (one per repository, names read from .gitmodules) and the platform layer under internal/. The drivers talk to the chips through interfaces that the platform layer implements for the MCU.
